main_staff.abstract:
We consider the problem of joint input design and parameter estimation for identifying nonlinear system models through
the sequential acquisition of measurements while adhering to system constraints. We utilize a receding horizon approach and
propose a new scale-invariant input design criterion, which is tailored to continuously updated parameter estimates, along with
a new sequential parameter estimator. We demonstrate the ability of the method to design informative experiments online,
while steering the system within operational constraints.
Key words: input design, adaptive design, constrained experiments
